workflow_class: Gray pointer FIFO and cross-clock memory
rationale: The 3-bit binary read pointer crosses into the write domain through one register, with no Gray coding and no synchroniser. Carry transitions such as 011 to 100 can be captured as arbitrary incoherent values.
caveats: The analyzer should report CDC-017 (counter, ERROR Heuristic when Async) as the primary finding, with CDC-004 as also_matches. The case is a pointer-observation slice, not a FIFO.

Raw rst_n asynchronously resets every register with no local release synchroniser and no SDC reset exception; RDC-003 (WARNING Unresolved), RDC-002 (WARNING Unresolved) and RDC-013 (physical obligation) are expected if RDC rules run. The contract states only asynchronous assertion, so this is a whole-IP premise gap, not a defect of the labelled crossing.

author_reading.class: Gray pointer FIFO and cross-clock memory
author_reading.title: FIFO read pointer crosses in binary
author_reading.rationale: This is a two-domain FIFO pointer observation: rd_bin is the read pointer, dst_clk is write domain, depth is eight. Pointer must be Gray-coded and synchronized; this intentionally crosses binary pointer directly.
limitations: Structural attribution is a proposal for independent adjudication, not analyzer outcome.
Physical timing and metastability requirements remain external.
